title: Risk factors and protective strategies for hypotony following preserflo microshunt implantation

indication: POAG, pseudoexfoliative and secondary glaucoma (retrospective cohort of 471 eyes)
decision: No admissible series: every IOP summary of the article is a median (IQR). Statistical analysis states that continuous variables were expressed as medians with interquartile ranges, and the Results describe the Table 3 values as median (IQR); the Table 3 cells have the form 'median (Q1, Q3)'. Protocol inclusion 3 excludes medians/IQR.
